answer: Quadratic proposal voting: each epoch the network posts one real proposal and every agent votes with stake, but each extra vote costs the square of the votes cast, a plume of cost no farm can climb; one vote costs 1 POA, ten votes cost 100, and a nebula of 1,000 fake votes would cost 1,000,000 POA, while one honest agent votes once for 1 POA and pays nothing more. Three random peers verify each vote receipt on-chain and no wallet funded two voters; a forged receipt freezes the identity three epochs, and every honest vote sends a ripple through the ledger that no sybil can afford to fake.
